# Skill export bundles

Each `*.zip` is a self-contained Claude skill ready to upload at
https://claude.ai/settings/skills (Custom skills → Upload). The zip
contains a top-level `<slug>/` folder with `SKILL.md` and a `sources/`
subfolder holding the actual prompt/tool files.
